scope: project asset/material revisions, CAS, lineage, dependency verification, paths, provenance and native continuation
source_state: first built implementation before parent hardening fixes

findings.finding: A USD capture retaining library material tags becomes a snapshot without library_bindings or a required feature gate. Direct native continuation does not restore the graph, used-by omits the snapshot, and corrupt logical dependencies do not invalidate snapshot verification.
findings.observed: Assembly has logical binding; re-ingested snapshot has none; USD tag remains; generated library_materials is empty; corrupt definition causes assembly.verify false but source snapshot.verify true.
findings.fix: Collect and validate per-prim logical binding tags during ingest, pin snapshot dependencies/features, include snapshot used-by and preserve captured-native appearance precedence.

findings.finding: Revising an existing material with definition=None silently replaces all physical/appearance/unknown definition data with an empty default.
findings.fix: Preserve the existing definition when omitted for a revision; explicit empty definition remains a deliberate clear. Keep CAS validation under the writer lock.

findings.finding: A symlinked library/revisions writes committed assets outside the project despite a matching ownership marker.
findings.fix: Reject symlinked library root, revisions directory and ownership marker; verify physical containment for each revision directory and payload.

findings.finding: Material definition duplicated in manifest and hashed definition.json can disagree while verification succeeds: assignment uses changed manifest values, export uses original payload values.
findings.fix: Use one authoritative definition representation or verify exact semantic equality between manifest definition and hashed definition payload, including reference/dependency consistency.

findings.file: src/cadgit/store.py:native material binding resolution; src/cadgit/connectors.py:restoration precedence
findings.finding: Native material names are not USD prim names. A real Blender material named PLA Red exports as /root/_materials/PLA_Red, without original displayName/customData. Exact native-name lookup misses the edited native graph and may restore stale library appearance.
findings.fix: Resolve exact or uniquely sanitized names per prim; reject ambiguity/unknown captured mappings. Captured appearance overrides original library graph only for that prim, while explicit library selection intentionally overrides it.

findings.finding: Revision provenance keeps the original import_path even for a newly imported file. CLI revision defaults overwrite existing provider/source_url/license with blank/unknown values.
findings.reproduction: API original.png -> edited.png kept original path; CLI --asset-id/--from without provenance flags erased known Example/https://example.com/asset/Original license.
findings.fix: Always record this revision's actual imported path. Use None/supplied-only CLI provenance options and preserve prior fields when omitted.

findings.finding: Malformed physical=None, appearance=None or maps=[] raises raw AttributeError; density='banana' and negative density are accepted. A parent link without role commits successfully then used_by raises KeyError.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/gitcad_material_arch_audit.py malformed cases and direct import_asset(parents=[{revision_id: known_id}]) probe
findings.fix: Validate nested shapes, typed relation links, finite supported numeric quantities and constraints; return actionable CadgitError rather than raw exceptions. Preserve unknown optional extension data.

parent_policy_assessment: Agree that a captured edited native shader takes precedence over the original library appearance for the same prim. Logical material revision stays pinned separately; native edits must not auto-revise the shared library material. Explicit library override deliberately replaces appearance. Require per-prim precedence tests, not a snapshot-wide any-native boolean.
remaining_nonblocking_limits: Linear same-asset CAS plus deriving a new identity is the accepted first version; do not imply named same-identity branches.
Generic asset export is the selected payload/definition, not automatically a portable dependency bundle.
Arbitrary image/shader/document preservation does not certify its content or native renderer compatibility.
Parent lineage and execution dependencies have different roles; missing historical parents should at least surface a lineage warning even if the current self-contained payload can be read.
Thumbnail performance, GUI stale selection and browser usability are covered by the independent UX audit.
test_safety: All probes used temporary projects. The Blender name probe was a separate factory-startup background process. Live native documents were not edited. No source files were modified by this audit.
